notes: Summary: Large omnichannel retailer, 30M catalog SKUs across categories, global storefronts. Looking to replace a legacy keyword and tag-based search + heuristic reranker.

Business goals: Increase conversion by improving first-page relevance during promotions; reduce overall infra cost vs current CPU-based brute-force rerank; maintain <100ms 95th p90 latency for search queries.
Traffic profile: baseline ~18k qps during business hours, anticipated seasonal peak 10x (Black Friday/windowed promos). Cache hit for top prefixes expected ~30% but long tail of tail queries remains.
POC scope agreed: index 5M SKUs (subset of catalog) for embeddings + vector store + Redwood rerank integration; measure end-to-end latency, token cost per query, and quality (NDCG top10).
Technical constraints: EU data residents for EU storefronts (need residency controls), corporate security requires SSO/SAML + KMS integration, audit logs retained 1 year.

Perf targets discussed: average end-to-end search latency (embedding retrieval + rerank) < 120ms p95 for low-load, <250ms during 5x peak with graceful degradation. Cost target: <$0.025 per query (including embed + rerank tokens + infra amortization) for production mix.
Model preferences: open to Llama-2 variants or smaller instruction-tuned encoders for embeddings; wants Redwood to recommend quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce GPU memory footprint.
Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to smaller model or cached results when Dedicated capacity saturated; must support deterministic A/B rollout by storefront/region.

- 2026-02-18: Cost model review. Aquila wants per-query cost breakdown (embeddings retrieval, rerank generation, infra). Goal: lower than $0.03/q for average session; prefer <$0.02 in optimized Dedicated setup.

- Week 3: Integrate Redwood rerank into search pipeline, run A/B against current production for selected storefronts.
- Week 4: Stress test with synthetic peak traffic (10x baseline) to validate autoscaling, fallback, and cache effectiveness.
